messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #25342 is green on unit tests but failing intermittent gpu-integration timeouts in CI. I want to land before the 00:00 UTC deploy blackout but we should stagger. Anyone able to help with a short canary and then a staggered merge?

devon: I can run a focused rerun on the gpu tests. last time a retry + isolate on a different runner helped.

maria: thanks — can you kick a rerun on a non-shared GPU runner? tag me when started.

devon: doing now. command I use:```ci retry --scope gpu-integration --runner=dedicated-gpu-2```

ci-bot: CI update for PR #25342 — gpu-integration: 1/3 failed (timeout), queued for rerun on dedicated-gpu-2 by devon. Log: `timeout on /dev/nvidia0 during dataset download`

ron: FYI release blackout starts 00:00 UTC. if we can get a successful canary in staging before 23:30 we can safely stagger the remainder at 23:45, otherwise we need to defer.

maria: can we do a canary merge to staging on the dedicated pool if devon confirms green? I can cut a quick rollback playbook.

devon: green on rerun. gpu logs look stable. ready for canary when you are.

jen: If you're doing a canary, ping me here when it lands. I'll hold off the global rollout until post-canary checks (10m). If anything weird, we abort and postpone past blackout.

maria: landing to staging at 23:18 UTC. will run smoke + perf probe (2m). revert steps saved in PR comment.

ci-bot: Deploy to staging started for PR #25342 at 1749200038. Status: deploying -> smoke tests pending.

devon: smoke passed. perf probe within normal bounds (latency +2%).

maria: great — rolling rest of the merge at 23:42 in two batches (owner + infra). scheduling in the merge queue now. :thumbsup:

jen: noted. I'll watch the rollout window and give final approve for prod after 10m canary.

ron: thanks team. documenting this as a staggered-merge case for future: mark CI flaky-gpu-runner as suspected cause and request dedupe on dataset download.

maria: agreed, will open an infra issue tomorrow and link CI logs. closing thread once merged.
